_readme: What's Good Local weekly deals feed for Destin. Written by the weekly scheduled task; see CLAUDE.md. The Crazy Good Deals page reads this file and merges it with the hand-picked LOCAL_DEALS list inside the page.

deals.name: AJ's Seafood & Oyster Bar
deals.deal: $15 dozen raw oysters, $5 house wines & $5.50 drafts, Mon-Fri 3-6 PM
deals.details: Happy hour Monday to Friday, 3 to 6 PM: $15 dozen raw, baked or steamed oysters, $7 Bimini Bash, $5 house wines, $5 Crown & Down, and $5.50 24 oz drafts. Weekday lunch specials around $12.95.

deals.name: Pandora's Steakhouse
deals.deal: 50% off wine, 35% off cocktails, daily 5-6:30 PM
deals.details: Daily bar happy hour, 5 to 6:30 PM: 50% off wine by the glass, 35% off cocktails and martinis, 33% off beer and spirits, 25% off frozen drinks and wine bottles. BOGO prime rib dinners Sundays and Wednesdays, 4 to 5 PM.

deals.name: Bitterroot
deals.deal: 30% off all appetizers + $10 cocktails, daily 3-6 PM (bar)
deals.details: Bar happy hour, 3 to 6 PM: all appetizers 30% off, house cocktails $10, beers $5, house wines $6. $5 Old Fashioneds on Mondays.

deals.name: Ruth's Chris Steak House
deals.deal: 'Sizzle & Sip': topped center-cut filet + cocktail, $49
deals.details: A topped center-cut filet plus a crafted cocktail for $49. Running through November 29, excludes Thanksgiving.

deals.name: Urban Air Adventure Park
deals.deal: Buy two Unlimited Play passes, get two more free (or pizza + Dippin' Dots)
deals.details: Buy two Unlimited Play or Unlimited Play+ tickets and pick a freebie: two more Unlimited Play tickets, or a single-topping pizza plus two Dippin' Dots. Tickets are good for 45 days. At participating Urban Air parks — confirm the local location takes part.

deals.name: The Ocean Club
deals.deal: Two-for-one entrées when you're seated before 6pm. Buy one, the second is free.
deals.details: Wednesday Locals Night: 30% off appetizers and alcohol at the bar and bar tables, after 7pm. Their early-dining menu page is down, so call to confirm which entrées are included.

deals.name: Pelican Parasail
deals.deal: Buy 1, get 1 half off on early morning flights.
deals.details: 5.0 on Tripadvisor. Early flights are also the calmest air of the day.

deals.name: Pelican Snorkeling Adventure
deals.deal: Buy 1, get 1 half off on snorkel trips.
deals.details: Emerald water, best visibility on calm mornings.

deals.name: The Gulf Club — Draft Wednesday
deals.deal: Buy one, get one free on any of 30 drafts, all day Wednesday.
deals.details: Second beer must be equal or lesser value. Trivia 6–8pm. They run a different deal every day — see Food & Drink below.

deals.name: The Wine Bar at Grand Boulevard
deals.deal: A full carafe for the price of a large glass, 11am–6pm daily. Effectively two-for-one wine, seven hours a day.
deals.details: Tuesday Locals' Night: carafe pricing all night, plus prime rib specials. Saturday Steak Night from 5pm. Closed Sundays.

deals.name: AJ's on the Bayou — Happy Hour
deals.deal: Two-for-one double-tall drafts, wines and cocktails, Tue–Fri 3–6pm — plus $15 dozen raw oysters.
deals.details: Kids eat free Tue–Fri 4–6pm. It stacks with happy hour, same window. This is a different business from AJ's Seafood on Destin Harbor.

deals.name: Cuvée 30A
deals.deal: Happy hour 4–7pm nightly in the bar: up to 50% off the bar food menu — flatbreads, seafood, burgers, entrées, soups, salads.
deals.details: Wine carafes 50% off, beer 33% off, craft cocktails and martinis 35% off. Dine-in only. Food orders must be in by 6:45pm.

deals.name: Brotula's Seafood House & Steamer
deals.deal: Happy hour 2–6pm daily — one of the longest windows on the harbor.
deals.details: Half-price house wine, well drinks and select drafts. $5 margaritas, $8 select apps. Wine Down Wednesday: half-price wines by the glass, 15% off bottles, 20% off the Captain's List.

deals.name: McGuire's Irish Pub
deals.deal: Half-price draft beer, wine and well drinks, every single day. 4–6pm daily, 3–6pm Fridays.
deals.details: Mon $3 margaritas from 6pm · Tue $4.99 double-shot martinis all day · Wed Mug Club $2 drafts Fri $4 vodka drinks from 6pm · Sat $3 Bushmills from 6pm The nightly specials aren't broken out by location — confirm with the Destin store.

deals.name: Marina Café
deals.deal: Happy hour daily 5–7pm: half-price drinks and half-price sushi.
deals.details: Half off wines, martinis, cocktails, domestic beers and select appetizers.

deals.name: Auston's on 98
deals.deal: Buck a Shuck 3–4pm Mon–Fri: $1 raw oysters, with happy hour running an hour behind it until 5.
deals.details: Happy hour 3–5pm Mon–Fri: $1.50 off all bar drinks, $5 house margaritas, $5 drink of the week. $3 Bud drafts all day, every day — not just the happy hour window. Potato skins $8 · fried gator bites with remoulade $11. 102-foot bar, 32 beers on draft, 37 TVs. They put college football on all day Saturday and the NFL all day Sunday.

deals.name: The Craft Bar
deals.deal: Happy hour Mon–Fri 2–6pm with a $5 menu.
deals.details: Select craft cocktails, beers, wines and chef-driven snacks.

deals.name: The Back Porch
deals.deal: Happy hour 3–5pm daily, and unusually cheap for a spot right on the sand.
deals.details: $3.75 drafts · $4 bottles · $5 wells and house wine · $6 margaritas and Bloody Marys Peel & eat shrimp $9.99. Destin is 3–5pm. Their Panama City Beach location runs 2–5pm.

deals.name: Pompano Joe's
deals.deal: Happy hour 2–4pm daily: $3.50 drafts, $5 house wine, $7.50 margaritas, $10 appetizers.
deals.details: Heads up: nearly every other site still lists this as 3–5pm. The restaurant says 2–4pm, and it's an easy window to miss.

deals.name: Mezcal Mexican Grill
deals.deal: Happy hour 2–5pm daily on a flat $5 menu — margaritas, beer, wine and appetizers, all the same price.
deals.details: The widely-repeated “Wednesday kids eat free” isn't on their site. Don't count on it.

deals.name: Boathouse Oyster Bar
deals.deal: “Where every hour is happy hour.” $3 Coors Light and $5 Miller Lite all day, every day.
deals.details: Raw oysters $14 half-dozen / $24 dozen. Oysters are dine-in only. No time window — this is just their everyday pricing.

deals.name: The Gulf Club
deals.deal: Seven different specials, one for each day, all running 11am–10pm.
deals.details: Mon half-price wings · Tue three-topping small pizza $10 Wed BOGO on any of 30 drafts + trivia 6–8pm Thu taco + house margarita $10, live music 6–9pm Fri Ladies Night — $5 martinis, cosmos, house wine, cocktails; DJ 6:30–9:30pm Sat & Sun extended happy hour 11am–6pm

deals.name: AJ's on the Bayou
deals.deal: The deepest slate of specials anywhere on the Emerald Coast.
deals.details: Happy hour Tue–Fri 3–6pm: $15 dozen raw oysters, 2-for-1 drafts, wines, cocktails. Kids eat free Tue–Fri 4–6pm — same window as happy hour. Lunch Tue–Fri 11a–4p, $12.95: pork chop, chicken parm, chicken piccata or fried chicken with sides. Thursday prime rib, 10oz with potato and salad, $24.95, 4pm until sold out. Wednesday Ladies Night 6–9pm: two free drinks after first purchase, $4.50 martinis. Sunday brunch 10a–3p with bottomless mimosas.

deals.name: AJ's Seafood — Weekday Specials
deals.deal: Separate from their happy hour, and much cheaper than the menu suggests.
deals.details: Taco Tuesday: $4 tacos, 11am–4pm. All-you-can-eat fried popcorn shrimp $19.95, Tuesdays. Thursday prime rib, 10oz with potato and salad, $24.95, 4–6pm. Weekday lunch $12.95, 11am–4pm — meatloaf Monday, pork chop Tuesday, chicken parm Wednesday, tea included.

deals.name: Jester Mardi Gras Daiquiris
deals.deal: $4.00 off — now $12.99 for a New Orleans-style frozen daiquiri.
deals.details: Mention What's Good Local to get the discount.

deals.name: Destin Vacation Boat Rentals
deals.deal: Off-season pontoon pricing is live now. These are real 30–40% cuts.
deals.details: 12-person Destin Harbor pontoon, half day: $375 → $225 through Oct 31. Full day $550 → $375. 12-person Crab Island pontoon, half day: $400 → $300. Double-decker with slides, 4 hours: $695 → $495. Show your tour armband at The Edge Seafood for 10% off — no code needed.
deals.location: Destin Harbor · Crab Island · Okaloosa Island

deals.name: Olin Marler Party Boat Fishing
deals.deal: $79 per person for four hours — the cheapest legitimate way to get offshore in Destin.
deals.details: Bait, tackle, fishing license and filleting all included. No license to buy — that's real hidden savings. 6 hours $99 · 8 hours $119 · 10 hours $135. Ages 7+. Morning departures 6–8am, year round. Crew works for tips (15–20% customary).

deals.name: Destin's Original Sea Blaster
deals.deal: Beach dolphin cruise, 90 minutes: $30 adult, $15 child, $4 toddler — taxes and fees included.
deals.details: Sunset dolphin cruise, 2 hours: $40 / $20 / $4. Snorkel + dolphin combo, 3 hours: $40 / $25 / $4.

deals.name: Crab Island Tours
deals.deal: The famous sandbar party spot, from $15–$79 per person.
deals.details: Float, swim, and eat off the boats. 5.0 on Google across 4,400+ reviews.

deals.name: Screaming Eagle Dolphin Tours
deals.deal: Sunset speedboat + dolphin tour - adults $44, kids (5-14) $25
deals.details: Sunset Screaming Eagle speedboat tour. Adults 15+ $44, children 5-14 $25 (42-inch height requirement). Running through November.

deals.name: Buccaneer Pirate Cruise
deals.deal: Kids' interactive pirate cruise - children (3-14) $34, group rate $34
deals.details: Adults $40, children ages 3-14 $34, infants 2 & under $10 (reservation required). Group rate $34 per ticket for 20 or more. Running through winter with limited hours.

deals.name: Floating Tiki Pub Sunset Cruise
deals.deal: Sunset dolphin cruise from $59 on a floating tiki bar.
deals.details: Waterslide, onboard bathroom, and it's BYOB. Dolphin sightings on most sunset runs.

deals.name: Southern Star Dolphin Cruise
deals.deal: Sunset dolphin cruise - adults $39, kids (3-14) $29, group $27
deals.details: Adults 15+ $39 (as low as $30 on select dates), children ages 3-14 $29, infants 2 & under $5 (reservation required). Group rate $27 per ticket for 20 or more - discounts apply to every sailing. Sailing select dates through fall and winter. 4.9 stars, 4,500+ Google reviews.

deals.name: Destin Water Taxi
deals.deal: $7 one way, $14 round trip for ages 6+. Children 5 and under $5 flat, infants free.
deals.details: Seven days a week, weather permitting. Peak season March–October. There's no all-day or multi-day pass, whatever other sites tell you. Round trip is the only bundle. Groups of 8+ should call ahead.

deals.name: Sunset Beach Service
deals.deal: Two chairs and an umbrella: $45 a day — but $255 for a week, which is $36.43/day, about 19% off.
deals.details: Monthly is $450, which works out to $15/day — a 67% discount and the real play for a long fall stay. Season runs March 1 to Oct 31. Rates exclude sales tax. Book online in advance or just pay the attendant on the beach.
deals.location: Destin · Crystal Beach · Okaloosa Island · Navarre

deals.name: EC Rider Day Pass
deals.deal: $4 all-day pass on the WAVE fixed routes. Single ride $2, free transfers.
deals.details: Cheapest way to get up and down 98 without parking or a rideshare. Reduced fares need an EC Rider ID or Medicare card — it's a disability program, not a senior or tourist discount. 31-day passes were discontinued after June 1, so confirm anything beyond the day pass.

deals.name: Serenity by the Sea Spa
deals.deal: 15% off select services for residents of Walton, Okaloosa, Escambia and Santa Rosa counties, Mon–Thu.
deals.details: ID required. Rotating daily extras — free dermaplane with a Tuesday HydraFacial, wine for two with Thursday pedicures. A 20% service charge applies to all prices.

deals.name: Silver Sands Premium Outlets
deals.deal: The old paid VIP coupon book is gone — Simon+ replaced it and it's free to join.
deals.details: Member offers typically run 10–25% off, or $10–$50 off thresholds, plus 2–3% cash back at select stores. Sign up on your phone in the parking lot. Takes about a minute.

deals.name: Destin Helicopter Tour
deals.deal: Aerial tour of Destin, Crab Island and the Emerald Coast — $59 per person.
deals.details: 4.7 on Google across 2,000+ reviews. Go at golden hour. The water color from 500 feet is the whole point.

deals.name: HarborWalk Adventures
deals.deal: Round-trip zip line $34.85. Forty-foot interactive LED rock wall $19.48.
deals.details: Must be over 50 lbs to ride. Right in the middle of HarborWalk, so it pairs with the free concerts. Zip line + rock wall combo available.

deals.name: Wild Willy's Adventure Zone
deals.deal: Combos beat à la carte by a wide margin, and military and public safety get 10% off year round.
deals.details: Two mini-golf courses together: $20.99 adult vs $27.98 separately. Drive & Play $19.49 adult / $17.49 child. Movie & Golf, Boat & Drive, Boat & Play all $17.99. Bonus points: $150 buys 195 points, $100 buys 125. Open daily 10a–10p. 4D theater, laser tag and VR are all indoors.

deals.name: The Track Family Fun Park
deals.deal: Point card sale running now: 250 pts $215 (save $35), 125 pts $110, 60 pts $55.
deals.details: Sun–Thu 11a–8p, Fri–Sat 11a–9p. New Tap & Play card required. Reload from your phone.

deals.name: Gulfarium Marine Adventure Park
deals.deal: Buy one animal encounter, get the second 50% off - code DOLPHIN50
deals.details: Use code DOLPHIN50 for animal encounters taking place October 26 through November 22.

deals.name: Sandestin Golf
deals.deal: Rates fall off a cliff after November overseeding. The Links drops from $119 to $59.
deals.details: The Links: $119 now → $59 Nov 10–23 → $89 after. Baytowne: $99 → $69 Nov 9–22. Raven: $159 → $109 from Nov 2. Cart and range balls included. Courses close briefly to overseed.

deals.name: Emerald Coast Science Center
deals.deal: Admission $15, under 2 free — and $5 per person for up to four with a SNAP/EBT card.
deals.details: Military and first responders 10% off. Fall hours Wed–Sat 10a–3p, closed Sun–Tue.

deals.name: Destin History & Fishing Museum
deals.deal: $10 admission, under 2 free, 10% off for military and first responders.
deals.details: Open Tue–Sat 10a–4p. Best paired with the October Fishing Rodeo happening two blocks away.

deals.name: Shrimp Basket
deals.deal: Free appetizer when you download the Shrimp Basket app ($10 min spend)
deals.details: Download the Shrimp Basket app and get a free appetizer with a $10 minimum spend.

deals.name: Shrimp Basket - Happy Hour
deals.deal: Happy hour Mon-Fri 2-5pm: $3 sips, $6 bites
deals.details: $3 domestic bottles, domestic drafts, house margaritas and house wines. $6 corn fritters, fried pickle chips, onion rings, smoked mahi dip.

deals.name: Baytowne on Ice
deals.deal: Outdoor ice skating - $15 for 90 minutes (+$3 skate rental)
deals.details: Baytowne on Ice seasonal rink, October 30 through February 7, times vary daily. Skaters must be at least 3 and fit appropriately sized skates; under 6 with an adult.

deals.name: Wednesday Night Concert Series - Holiday Edition
deals.deal: Free live music + visits with Santa (Dec 2 & 16)
deals.details: Free Wednesday Night Concert Series, holiday edition, at the Village of Baytowne Wharf with visits with Santa. December 2 and December 16.
